title: Open WebUI Playwright web loader -- T1190 unvalidated sub-resource requests reach blocked internals
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70479 (GHSA-w2rx-84hp-gg95,
CVSS 7.7 HIGH), affecting Open WebUI from 0.9.6 until 0.11.0.

With `WEB_LOADER_ENGINE=playwright`, the Playwright web loader validated
only the TOP-LEVEL page request against the blocked-address policy,
letting SUB-RESOURCE requests the loaded page issues (via its own
JavaScript) pass entirely unvalidated. An authenticated user supplying
a URL can have that page's script reach internal addresses the
top-level check would have refused, and the returned DOM -- including
data read from those internal addresses -- flows into web-search or RAG
output that the requesting user then sees.

Detection logic flags a Playwright-rendered page fetch whose CAPTURED
sub-resource requests (network requests the browser context issued
while rendering) target a private/loopback/link-local address the
top-level URL itself did not -- since the top-level check already
passed by definition, only a sub-resource mismatch indicates the gap
this advisory describes.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact PR), fixed in 0.11.0.
